procedure.en: Ships factory-calibrated for espresso. There is no zero to find: setting 1 is the finest position on the printed 1–40 hopper ring.
procedure.pt-BR: Sai de fábrica calibrado para espresso. Não há zero a ser encontrado: a posição 1 é a mais fina do anel impresso de 1 a 40 no reservatório.

notes: Two resolutions on one dial: settings 1–20 are micro-steps for espresso (Baratza: about 20 µm per step), settings 21–40 are macro-steps for brewed coffee. Do not treat the dial as one linear slope. Honest Coffee Guide's computed slope for the macro zone is about 37 µm per step; both figures are estimates. Baratza's micro/macro description: baratza.com/en-us/blog/product-guides/dialing-in-espresso.
